annotations.title: Direct Booking vs OTA Savings Calculator

description: Compares the net room revenue a hotel keeps per booking from an OTA (after commission and, for pay-at-hotel bookings, card fees) and from a direct booking (after rate discount, booking engine, marketing, per-booking costs and card fees). Returns annual distribution costs by channel, the saving from moving a number of percentage points of room nights from OTAs to direct, and break-even direct costs. Direct-channel costs start at 0: pass your own. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/direct-booking-vs-ota-calculator

adr.description: Average daily rate (room revenue per occupied room night).

bookingEnginePercent.description: Booking engine fee, % of direct booking value.

cardFeeFixed.description: Card processing fee, fixed amount per booking (example default 0.2, in GBP).

cardFeePercent.description: Card processing fee, % of the amount charged (example default 1.5%).

directCostPerBooking.description: Fixed cost per direct booking (cost-per-click spend, per-booking engine fee, perk value).

directDiscountPercent.description: Direct-booking rate discount (e.g. member rate), % off the ADR.

marketingPercent.description: Metasearch, paid search and other marketing, % of direct booking value.

otaCommissionPercent.description: OTA commission, % of booking value, including any visibility programme uplift. Typical 15–30%; the default of 18% is a modelling choice.

otaPayment.description: 'ota' = prepaid to the OTA, which pays you net; 'property' = pay at hotel, you take the card payment.

otaSharePercent.description: Share of room nights booked through OTAs, %. Default: 22.2% (five-star hotels in Europe, 2023).

roomNights.description: Room nights sold per year, all channels.

shiftPoints.description: Percentage points of room nights moved from OTAs to direct (example default 5).

name: direct-booking-vs-ota-calculator
